query: Make this build production-safe: it must be impossible to ship localhost URLs or an unfinished page to production, and add a staging mode that is public but never indexed. The build reads SITE_URL; production builds run with SITE_URL=https://acme-widgets.test and PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true, staging builds with SITE_URL=https://staging.acme-widgets.test and without PUBLIC_INDEXABLE. CI also runs Lighthouse on an indexable build served locally (SITE_URL=http://localhost:4321 PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true LIGHTHOUSE_CI=true); that build must keep working.
expected_behavior: An indexable build with SITE_URL missing, empty or on localhost fails, except the explicit Lighthouse CI build, which keeps working and is covered by a test.
An indexable build refuses visible placeholder text (Lorem ipsum, TODO, TBD).
A build without PUBLIC_INDEXABLE is non-indexable: noindex on every page (tag or X-Robots-Tag) and a robots.txt that does NOT disallow everything, so the noindex can be read.

The output checks are wired into npm test: npm test builds and runs check-site --dist (or an equivalent) on the built output, so a defect in the output (an og:image whose file is missing) turns it red.
npm test fails when the original build.mjs is put back.
